// closure: a func literal capturing enclosing names by cell. The
// handler reads greeting, observing the program's later write, and
// writes last, which the program reads back: write-through in both
// directions, with the mux serving during the defining run.
mux := http.NewServeMux();
greeting := fmt.Sprint("hello");
last := fmt.Sprint("none");
mux.HandleFunc("/greet", func(w, r) {
	last = fmt.Sprint(r.URL.Path);
	fmt.Fprint(w, greeting);
});
req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/greet");
rec := httptest.NewRecorder();
mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req);
assert.Equal(tb, "hello", rec.Body.String());
assert.Equal(tb, "/greet", last);
greeting = "changed";
rec2 := httptest.NewRecorder();
mux.ServeHTTP(rec2, req);
assert.Equal(tb, "changed", rec2.Body.String());
